notes: This file is a human-maintained overlay for research data that TTS does not encode structurally.
Topology (rows, path nodes, forward edges, scores) should come from src/ResearchTrackData.ttslua.
Fill only costs/rewards that are visible on the printed board/rulebook and verify them against the physical board.
Resource keys: coin, compass, tablet, arrowhead, jewel.
Reward codes should remain declarative; the engine resolves them separately.

bridges.comment: Example entry only. Replace values after checking the board.

nodeRewards.comment: Use this only when a reward belongs to the destination node rather than the bridge.
